text:
Taylor: Quick sync 10% cohort siphon to green cluster for release `v2.3.0-canary` tonight 20:30 PT. Goal: observe p95 and token cost before larger ramp.
Mina: Ack. Cohort plan? regional or global?
Carlos: Regional start (us-west-2), cadence 0->10->30->60->100 with holds 5m, 7m, 5m, 3m. Fast-abort target: shrink to 0 within 90s if triggered.
Taylor: We'll pin image `inference:v2.3.0-20260321`. Disable auto updates for the pool during the window.
Mina: Rollback triggers to wire into watchers:
- 1m error rate > 1% for two consecutive minutes
- p95 +350ms vs baseline for 5m
- QA Bot flags generation drop
deploy-bot: I'll watch and post step confirmations. Config snippet: ```yaml
watchers:
  - metric: http_error_rate
    window: 1m
    threshold: 0.01
    consecutive: 2
    action: fast_abort
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    window: 5m
    threshold: 350
    action: shrink_then_abort
```
Carlos: Prewarm caches during 10% for 4m: `./tools/prewarm --target green --qps 30 --duration 240`.
Taylor: Manual advance past 30% only. deploy-bot wait on my `start` then `advance` commands. Oncall Bot will page on fast_abort.
Oncall Bot: Confirmed. Creating incident #inc-179999-90 if fired.
Mina: Also set LB cookie TTL to 25m; note router may still re-route due to soft stickiness.
Taylor: All set. If no objections I will `start` at 20:25 PT for a 20:30 rollout.
Carlos: Ready.
Mina: Ready.
Taylor: start
deploy-bot: STEP: set-weight 10% -> green (us-west-2) 120:30 PT scheduled, executing now.``
